Laura — thanks for the heads up and the files. Quick summary from accounting:

1) Treatment recommendation: invoice offset in our billing system is preferable for speed and to avoid creating a revenue-impacting external credit on the AR aging. We can instead record a contra-revenue allowance (promo allowance) and apply an offset against the outstanding invoice.

2) When to issue a credit memo: issue a formal credit memo PDF only if the customer explicitly needs an invoice-level credit on their accounting records (Samir indicated they prefer a PDF for AP). In that case we can produce a proforma credit memo that references the invoice number and the original charge, then post an internal journal to offset revenue and reduce receivables.

3) GLA / JE guidance (for month-end):
- Debit: 5701 Promo Allowance Expense (or contra-revenue account if you prefer) — $1,720
- Credit: 4100 Accounts Receivable — Customer (apply offset) — $1,720
- If issuing formal credit memo, we will also create a memo referencing deal GW-2027-04-15-TRIAL and insert memo ID in the JE.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm whether GreenWave needs the formal PDF for AP records. If yes, finance will draft the proforma and we’ll send for signature/ack.
- Neha: can you confirm the GLA suggestion above and whether to use 5701 vs a different promo code for revenue reporting?
- Priyom: please flag if revenue ops prefers a specific billing workflow for offsets vs memos (we should avoid double-applying).

If the customer wants the PDF I can produce the proforma by EOD and we’ll route it through the standard JE flow.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
